name: Limassol

queries.query: Cyprus official cadastral map parcel viewer Limassol Department of Lands and Surveys GIS
queries.result: Official Gov.cy and DLS Portal pages identify the Department of Lands and Surveys interactive maps, and the official English ArcGIS REST cadastral service exposes a public Parcels polygon layer and query endpoint.

queries.query: Κύπρος επίσημος κτηματολογικός χάρτης τεμάχια Λεμεσός Τμήμα Κτηματολογίου GIS
queries.result: Official Greek Gov.cy/DLS pages identify map navigation for cadastral data and the Greek ArcGIS REST cadastral map; the Greek layer metadata describes ΤΕΜΑΧΙΑ (parcels) as polygon data with the same public service footprint.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: The official Cyprus Department of Lands and Surveys (DLS) Portal is the cadastral-map custodian and provides the public interactive map service; the evidence is national rather than a separate Limassol municipal GIS.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalAgency: Department of Lands and Surveys, Ministry of Interior, Cyprus.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: The official DLS interactive-map service explicitly provides cadastral parcels and identification/map details, and its public ArcGIS REST Parcels layer returned bounded parcel polygons near Limassol.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official English service page states that users can navigate to properties and view parcel layers, identify properties, and inspect map details.
Current English DLS Portal loaded and links InteractiveMaps, with Limassol listed as a DLS district office.
Official Greek service page describes navigation to cadastral/survey data, parcel search and administrative boundaries.

Live official layer metadata identified Parcels as esriGeometryPolygon, supported JSON/geoJSON queries, native Web Mercator service extent, and safe fields including SBPI_ID_NO, OBJECTID, parcel number, sheet and plan.
Live official Greek layer metadata identified ΤΕΜΑΧΙΑ (parcels) as polygon data in the same national cadastral service footprint.

A 1 km x 1 km envelope centered on the exact WUP point returned three Polygon features with safe native SBPI_ID_NO values 595062, 597262 and 597258. Full unchanged response is retained only in ignored tmp evidence; no source-specific attributes are retained in the packet.

Exact-point identify at the preserved WUP point returned zero features. This is a point-scale result only and is not evidence of citywide absence; the bounded envelope query returned parcel polygons nearby.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: The current DLS Portal and its linked official ArcGIS REST service were inspected; the public service endpoint is directly usable without login or private tokens.
schemaAndCrs.parcelLayer: National/CadastralMap_EN/MapServer/0 (Parcels); Greek counterpart is National/CadastralMap_GR/MapServer/0 layer 0 (ΤΕΜΑΧΙΑ).
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Service/native metadata: EPSG:3857 (WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857). The bounded response requested outSR=4326; no sample file was retained.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: SBPI_ID_NO is the source parcel identifier returned by the official layer. DIST_CODE, VIL_CODE, QRTR_CODE, BLCK_CODE and PARCEL_NBR are source cadastral components available for provenance; no synthetic row number was used.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: 1 km x 1 km envelope centered on exact WUP point [34.6909748253836, 33.0357356736213] in latitude/longitude order; coordinates were not shifted.

safeFieldAllowlist: public source layer and service metadata

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Exact point returned zero features; a nearby bounded envelope returned three polygons. No coordinate shift was used.
geometryDecision.retentionDecision: No GeoJSON sample retained; the task permits zero samples and the unchanged response remains in ignored temporary evidence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The DLS service is national Cyprus cadastral-map coverage according to its official service description.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three parcel polygons were verified in one bounded anonymous response near Limassol; local citywide completeness, update cadence and all municipal limits were not independently measured.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
scopeLimits: This is cadastral-source research, not source integration or runtime admission.
The exact WUP point and population values were preserved; no coordinate was moved to force a parcel hit.
The exact-point zero and three nearby polygons are bounded evidence, not citywide coverage proof.
Only safe IDs and geometry were used; raw source-specific attributes remain only in ignored temporary evidence.
No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe field request was used.
uncertainty: The official DLS national cadastral service is a credible public parcel source and returned safe native IDs plus polygon geometry near Limassol. The exact WUP point is not itself inside a returned parcel at point-query scale, and citywide completeness, current viewer internals beyond the public REST service, and production adapter suitability remain for independent serial review.
